title: Linear truncation for conditioned prime-factor fibres
summary: In previous joint work with Tenenbaum, the truncation step $f \mapsto f_R$ in the conditional effective Erdos-Wintner theorem on the fibre $ω(n)=k$ yields, in the continuous case for real strongly additive $f$, a remainder of size $η_f(R)^{r/(r+1)}$, where $R$ is the truncation level and $r=k/\log\log x$. We prove an effective linear truncation lemma showing that, in the central window $κ\le r \le 1/κ$, this bound improves to the natural linear scale $rη_f(R)$ under an effective Sathe-Selberg-type ratio estimate for the fibre. This yields a direct effective sharpening of the truncation step…
